summary: Goldgroup Mining Inc. filed a Form 6-K (Canadian foreign private issuer report, the US analogue of a current report on Form 8-K) carrying a Material Change Report dated July 31, 2026, disclosing that on July 27, 2026 CEO and President Allen Palmiere stepped down and Board Chair Javier Reyes was named Interim Chief Executive Officer while a search for a permanent CEO proceeds. Palmiere is expected to remain an advisor. No price, stake, premium, advisor or financing terms were disclosed. Watch for permanent CEO appointment, interim-officer disclosure gaps, and any strategic review or asset sale that follows.
